chiretta.definition:
n. A plant (Agathotes Chirayta) found in Northern India,

   febrifuge.

a. 快活的, 兴致好的
v. (使)高兴

chirked.definition: v make a shrill creaking, squeaking, or noise, as of a door, mouse, or bird

chirm.definition:
v. i. To chirp or to make a mournful cry, as a bird.
n. Clamor, or confused noise; buzzing.
chirm.translation:
n. 鸟鸣声
v. (鸟)吱喳叫, 唱

chiro.translation: abbr. chirography 书法; 笔法; chiropractic 脊椎指压治疗法; chiropractor 脊椎指压治疗者

chirognomy.definition:
n. The art of judging character by the shape and
   appearance of the hand.
chirognomy.translation: n. 手相术, 观掌术

chirograph.definition:
n. A writing which, requiring a counterpart, was engrossed
   twice on the same piece of parchment, with a space between, in which
   was written the word chirographum, through which the parchment was cut,
   and one part given to each party. It answered to what is now called a
   charter party.
n. The last part of a fine of land, commonly called the
   foot of the fine.
chirograph.translation:
n. 正式签字的文件, 亲笔字据
[法] 正式签字的文件, 教皇亲笔特许证书

chirographer.definition:
n. One who practice the art or business of writing or
   engrossing.
n. See chirographist, 2.

chirographical.definition: a. Of or pertaining to chirography.

chirography.translation:
n. 书法, 笔法, 笔迹
[法] 书法, 笔迹书法, 书体

chirogymnast.definition:
n. A mechanical contrivance for exercising the fingers
   of a pianist.

chirol.translation: 开洛尔(多种树脂及油类溶于乙醚与乙醇)

chirology.definition: n telling fortunes by lines on the palm of the hand

chiromancer.definition: n fortuneteller who predicts your future by the lines on your palms

chiromancy.definition: n telling fortunes by lines on the palm of the hand

chiromantical.definition: a. Of or pertaining to chiromancy.

chirometer.translation: [医] 量手器(骨盆手测法用)

chiron.definition:
n (Greek mythology) the learned centaur who tutored Achilles, Asclepius, Hercules, Jason, and other heroes
n an asteroid discovered in 1977; it is unique in having an orbit lying mainly between the orbits of Saturn and Uranus

chironomus.definition: n type genus of the Chironomidae

chiropody.definition: n the branch of medicine concerned with the feet
chiropody.translation:
n. 足病学
[医] 手足医术

chiropractic.definition: n. a method of treatment that manipulates body structures (especially the spine) to relieve low back pain or even headache or high blood pressure

n. (脊柱)按摩疗法

n. 翼手目动物

(chirrup 的过去时) n. 吱喳声
